Fabrikam Retail Group

Accounting & Controllership Intern, Summer 2027
New York, NY (on-site)

About the role
Join our Controllership team for a 10-week summer internship. You will support the
monthly close, prepare account reconciliations, and help the team document
internal controls ahead of our annual audit.

What you'll do
- Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and journal entries
- Analyze variances between budget and actuals in Excel
- Document internal controls for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) testing

Requirements
- Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
- Completed Intermediate Accounting I
- Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP)
- Interest in pursuing the CPA
